rationale: Despite strong post-gap buying momentum that has driven the price 95.4% up its intraday range on 13.3x relative volume, FTNT is currently overextended by more than three 5-minute ATRs above both its session VWAP ($133.42) and 9-EMA ($133.32). Initiating a long at current levels offers poor risk-to-reward, while shorting directly into making new intraday highs lacks confirmation of buyer exhaustion, especially given the wide 14.5 bps spread and tight remaining daily loss budget.
